segments.thag5.5:1.1: “Sādhū hi kira me mātā, patodaṃ upadaṃsayi;
segments.thag5.5:3.1: “Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca, ye me vijjiṃsu āsavā;
segments.thag5.5:3.3: Sabbe asesā ucchinnā, na ca uppajjare puna.
segments.thag5.5:4.3: ‘Apihā nūna mayipi, vanatho te na vijjati’.

lines: Idāni “tayā niyojitākāreneva mayā paṭipannan”ti dassento “pariyantakatan”ti osānagāthamāha, tassattho suviññeyyova.
